children.name: text
children: {b:Section 1 – Definitions and Interpretation}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.1}

children.name: text
children: Delete the definition of {b:Funder} and replace with:

children.name: text
children: ""{b:Funder}" means a person (whether acting for himself and/or where leading for a syndicate of persons as agent and trustee for such persons) who is providing or shall provide interim or other finance for the carrying out of the Main Contract Works or any part thereof and/or for the acquisition of the Site."

children.name: text
children: In the definition of {b:Interest Rate}, delete "5" and insert "2".

children.name: text
children: In the definition of {b:Numbered Documents}, insert "{b:part 2 of}" after "listed in".

children.name: text
children: In the definition of {b:Payment Application}, delete "see clauses 4.6.2 and 4.6.3" and insert "a particularised payment application containing all such information required under {b:Numbered Document ND17} and in accordance with clauses 4.6.2 and 4.6.3 and showing the amount that the Sub-Contractor considers due to it on the relevant due date and the basis upon which that sum has been calculated".

children.name: text
children: Delete the definition of {b:Purchaser} and replace with:

children.name: text
children: ""{b:Purchaser}" means a person who has acquired or has agreed to acquire or may later acquire or agree to acquire a freehold interest in the whole or any part of the Site (and/or any premises constructed or to be constructed on the Site) and "Purchasers" shall be construed accordingly."

children.name: text
children: Delete the definition of {b:Retention Release Date.}

children.name: text
children: Delete the definition of {b:Sub-Contract Agreement} and insert "the Agreement entered into by the Parties in connection with the Sub-Contract Works consisting of the Recitals, the Articles, the Sub-Contract Particulars and the Main Contract Information Schedule".

children.name: text
children: Delete the definition of {b:Tenant} and replace with:

children.name: text
children: ""{b:Tenant}" means a person who has taken or has agreed to take or may later take or agree to take a lease of the whole or any part of the Site (and/or any premises constructed or to be constructed on the Site) and "Tenants" shall be construed accordingly."

children.name: text
children: Insert the following new definitions:

children.name: text
children: "{b:Associated Person}" means a person (including an employee, agent or subsidiary) who performs services for or on behalf of the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: "{b:Bribery Act}" means the Bribery Act 2010.

children.name: text
children: "{b:Builder's Quantities}" means the method for measurement of bills set out in {b:Numbered Document ND103} and deemed to make allowance/include for all works as may reasonably be envisaged as being necessary to carry out the works generally described and intended including but not limited to all labours, sundries, protection and the like.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Regulations"} means the Building Regulations 2010 (SI 2010/2214).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Regulations Principal Contractor"} means the Principal Contractor for the purposes of the Building Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Regulations Principal Designer"} means the Principal Designer for the purposes of the Building Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Safety Laws"} means together:

children.name: text
children: the Building Safety Act 2022;

children.name: text
children: the Defective Premises Act 1972;

children.name: text
children: the Building Act 1984;

children.name: text
children: the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: where the Main Contract Works constitute HRB Work, the HRB Regulations;

children.name: text
children: any instrument, regulation, rule, order, code of practice or guideline made under the foregoing having the force of law which affects the Main Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: any guidance issued by a government department, the Building Safety Regulator and/or the Health and Safety Executive in connection with the foregoing and/or any instrument, regulation, rule, order, code of practice or guideline relating to the foregoing; and

children.name: text
children: any building safety laws and regulations now or from time to time in force which affects the Main Contract Works or performance of any obligations under this Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Safety Regulator"} means the Building Safety Regulator as defined by the Building Safety Act 2022 and/or any other regulatory body or government department for the time being performing the role of the regulator under the relevant Building Safety Laws.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Consents"} means the planning permissions referred to in the Contractor's Requirements or any other planning permissions relating to the Sub-Contract Works and/or Main Contract Works, approval of reserved matters and all details pursuant thereto, building regulation approval, fire officer approval and any other permissions, approvals, certificates and licences that may be necessary pursuant to Statutory Requirements or otherwise to the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works and/or Main Contract Works and, if they are destroyed or damaged, the reinstatement of the Sub-Contract Works and/or Main Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Contractor's Health and Safety Requirements"} means those requirements set out in {b:Numbered Document ND29.}

children.name: text
children: {b:"Corrupt Activity"} means extortion, fraud, deception, collusion, membership of cartels, abuse of power, embezzlement, trading in influence, money-laundering or any similar activity, bribery and/or corruption including, without limitation, any activity, practice or conduct which would or could constitute an offence under sections 1, 2 or 6 Bribery Act whether in connection with the Sub-Contract Works or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Covid-19"} means the virus known as severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-COV-2) and the disease known as coronavirus disease (COVID-19), both as identified and named as such by the world health organisation or any other virus/strain linked to COVID-19.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Data Protection Legislation"} means the retained EU law version of the General Data Protection Regulation ((EU) 2016/679) (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018 (as amended) and any other laws or regulations relating to privacy or personal data applicable in England and Wales.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Group Company"} means any subsidiary or holding company of the Contractor or another subsidiary or holding company of such company as subsidiary and holding company are defined in section 1159 Companies Act 2006.

children.name: text
children: {b:"First Retention Release Date"} see the Sub-Contract Particulars (item 11).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Force Majeure"} means the occurrence, after the date of this Sub-Contract, of events or circumstances:

children.name: text
children: which are beyond a Party's reasonable control;

children.name: text
children: could not have been reasonably foreseen or provided against before the date of this Sub-Contract;

children.name: text
children: having arisen, such Party could not reasonably have avoided or overcome;

children.name: text
children: whose effects are not confined wholly or principally to the Parties, the Site or the Main Contract Works,

children.name: text
children: provided that neither the failure to secure labour, goods or materials that are essential to the proper carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works nor any strike by the Sub-Contractor's or any Sub-Contractor's Persons' workforce shall constitute force majeure.

children.name: text
children: {b:"HRB Regulations"} means the Building (Higher-Risk Buildings Procedures) (England) Regulations 2023 SI 2023/909 issued pursuant to the Building Safety Act 2022.

children.name: text
children: {b:"HRB Work"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Key Activity Date"} means those dates identified as such on the Programme and/or in {b:Numbered Document ND105} and/or {b:ND106.}

children.name: text
children: {b:"Modern Slavery Legislation"} means the Modern Slavery Act 2015 including, without limitation, the legislation referred to in section 54 of the Modern Slavery Act 2015.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Moral Rights"} means moral rights under Chapter IV Part I Copyright Designs and Patents Act 1988.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Nominating Notice"} means a written notice in the form set out in {b:Numbered Document ND11} which may be issued for and on behalf of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Outstanding Warranties"} has the meaning given to it in clause 2.26.3.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Personal Data"} means any data relating to an identified or identifiable individual that are within the scope of protection as "personal data" under the applicable Data Protection Legislation.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Programme"} means the programme for the Sub-Contract Works contained in {b:Numbered Document ND105} and/or {b:ND106}, as may be revised from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Reverse Charge Order"} means the Value Added Tax (Section 55A) (Specified Services and Excepted Supplies) Order 2019.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Second Retention Release Date"} see the Sub-Contract Particulars (item 11).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Site"} shall have the meaning given to it in the Main Contract (or if not defined therein it shall mean the site of the Main Contract Works) and all references to the "site" in this Sub-Contract shall be deemed to be "Site".

children.name: text
children: {b:"Sub-Sub Contractor Competency Requirements"} means those requirements for sub-contracting set out in {b:Numbered Document ND29.}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.3}

children.name: text
children: Delete clause and insert the following:

children.name: text
children: "Subject always to clauses 2.10 and 2.11, in the event of any inconsistency or conflict occurring between the contents of respectively, and in the following order:

children.name: text
children: the HRB Supplemental Modifications Schedule;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contract Modifications Schedule;

children.name: text
children: the Articles of Agreement;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contract Particulars (excluding item 18 of the Sub-Contract Particulars for the purposes of this clause 1.3);

children.name: text
children: the clauses set out in sections 1 to 8 of the printed JCT Design and Build Sub-Contract Conditions 2016 and the schedules thereto;

children.name: text
children: the Numbered Documents prepared by the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: the Numbered Documents prepared or provided by the Sub-Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: the Main Contract Information Schedule,

children.name: text
children: then the contents of the document earlier in the order shall prevail over any document later in the order. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict occurring between the Contractor's Requirements and the Sub-Contractor's Proposals the Contractor's Requirements shall take precedence."

children.name: text
children: Delete clause 1.6 and insert the following:

children.name: text
children: "Other than such rights as take effect pursuant to clause 2.27, nothing in this Sub-Contract confers or purports to confer any rights on any person pursuant to the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999."

children.name: text
children: In line 3 after "in such format as" insert "set out in {b:Numbered Document ND17} or as".

children: Delete clause 1.8.1.1 and insert "Not Used".

children: Delete clause 1.8.1.2 and insert "Not Used".

children.name: text
children: Delete "clause 3.1" and insert "clauses 3.1 and 2.26".

children.name: text
children: At the end of the clause insert "Any consent or approval requested of the Contractor which requires the Employer's consent or approval under the Main Contract shall not be considered to have been unreasonably withheld or delayed to the extent that the Employer has withheld or delayed its approval or consent."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.11}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clause 1.11 as follows:

children.name: text
children: This Sub-Contract contains the entire agreement between the Parties concerning its subject matter. Any previous understanding, agreement (including, but not limited to, any letter of intent or pre-construction services agreement entered into between the Parties), representation or warranty relating to that subject matter (whether written or oral) is superseded and replaced by this Sub-Contract and has no further effect.

children.name: text
children: Each Party acknowledges that in entering into this Sub-Contract it does not rely on, and shall have no remedies in respect of, any statement, representation, assurance or warranty (whether made innocently or negligently) that is not set out in this Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: Each Party agrees that it shall have no claim for innocent or negligent misrepresentation based on any statement in this Sub-Contract."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.12}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clause 1.12 as follows:

children.name: text
children: "Notwithstanding the date of this Sub-Contract it shall have effect as if it had been executed upon the date the Sub-Contractor first performed any work (including design, enabling, temporary or other preliminary demolition or permanent works) or activities in relation to the Sub-Contract Works (whether under a letter of intent or otherwise) and accordingly the duties and obligations contained in this Sub-Contract shall be deemed to have applied to the carrying out of any of those works and/or the Sub-Contract Works prior to the date of this Sub-Contract. All payments made in respect of works carried out prior to the date of this Sub-Contract shall be treated as payments on account of sums due under this Sub-Contract."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.13}

children.name: text
children: Insert a new clause 1.13 as follows:

children.name: text
children: No failure or delay by the Contractor to exercise any right or remedy provided under this Sub-Contract or by law shall constitute a waiver of that or any other right or remedy, nor shall it preclude or restrict the further exercise of that or any other right or remedy. No single or partial exercise of such right or remedy shall preclude or restrict the further exercise of that or any other right or remedy

children.name: text
children: No enquiry, payment, inspection, approval, sanction, comment, consent, decision or instruction at any time made or given by or on behalf of the Contractor or any person pursuant to the terms of the Main Contract (nor any failure or delay in the same) shall operate to exclude or limit the Sub-Contractor's obligations under this Sub-Contract."

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 2 – Carrying out the Sub-Contract Works}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.1}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clauses 2.1.4 to 2.1.8 as follows:

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall keep confidential and shall not disclose to any person (save for essential employees in the proper course of their duties, its legal or other advisors, and any law enforcement or other regulatory bodies (in each case to the extent necessary for the performance of its obligations under this Sub-Contract)) any information not already in the public domain relating to this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works and the business of the Contractor, the Employer and any other third parties with an interest in the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works and/or the Site. The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that any persons having access to such information are aware of these obligations and are similarly bound. The obligations contained in this clause 2.1.4 shall survive any termination of this Sub-Contract or the Sub-Contractor's engagement hereunder.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not without the prior written approval of the Contractor take or permit to be taken any photographs of the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works, the Site or any part thereof for use in any publicity or advertising or publish alone or in conjunction with any other person, any articles, photographs or other illustrations in any publication journal or newspaper or any radio or television programme or internet site in relation to the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works, the Site or any part thereof.

children.name: text
children: Without limiting the Sub-Contractor's obligations under this Sub-Contract or pursuant to the Building Safety Laws, the Sub-Contractor shall:

children.name: text
children: comply, and procure compliance by the Sub-Contractor's Persons with the Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: co-operate and collaborate with the Contractor, the Employer and the Building Safety Regulator to ensure compliance with the Building Safety Laws and co-operate with and support the Contractor and any other person working on or in relation to the Main Contract Works to enable such person(s) to fulfil their duties or functions under the Building Safety Laws (including the roles of Building Regulations Principal Contractor and Building Regulations Principal Designer);

children.name: text
children: ensure the work carried out by him (and by any workers under his control) is planned, managed and monitored so as to be in compliance with all relevant requirements under the Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: provide to the Contractor as soon as reasonably practicable following such request and without charge, any information regarding the Sub-Contract Works that may be required in connection with the Building Safety Laws and/or the Contractor may require in order to comply with all relevant requirements;

children.name: text
children: not do permit to be done anything which will result, or is likely to result, in the Contractor or the Employer being in breach of any Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: perform his duties under the Building Safety Laws so as to minimise any delay to, or additional cost in connection with, the carrying out of the Main Contract Works and so as to enable any other party with duties under the Building Safety Laws to perform such duties timeously;

children.name: text
children: if required, provide input into any applications and/or notices required pursuant to Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: on appointing any person, keep and provide to the Contractor on request a record, in writing, of the steps the person making the appointment took in accordance with regulation 11E (considerations before a person carries out work) of the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: promptly notify the Contractor and (where those roles are not being performed by the Contractor) the Building Regulations Principal Designer and Building Regulations Principal Contractor of any incidents or situations that should be reported in accordance with the 'mandatory occurrence reporting system' in accordance with the Building Safety Laws; and

children.name: text
children: promptly comply with any contravention notice issued by the Building Safety Regulator relating to any part of the Sub-Contract Works. Where the issue of any such contravention notice was a result of any negligence or breach by the Sub-Contractor, the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any addition to the Sub-Contract Sum or any extension of time.

children.name: text
children: If any work, materials or goods are covered up in contravention of a notice from the Building Safety Regulator requiring specified work to remain uncovered for a specified time, the Sub-Contractor will comply with all instructions of the Building Safety Regulator, including any compliance or stop notices, and any directions of the Contractor under clause 3.4 as applicable, and no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given whatever the results of the opening up.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall in carrying out its obligations under this Sub-Contract:

children.name: text
children: comply with Data Protection Legislation; and

children.name: text
children: process Personal Data in accordance with (and so as not to put the Contractor or the Employer in breach of) the Data Protection Legislation and only to the extent necessary for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Sub-Contract

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.3}

children.name: text
children: Delete clause 2.3 and insert the following:

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works regularly and diligently in accordance with the Key Activity Dates and other programme requirements identified in the Sub-Contract Particulars (Item 5) and {b:Numbered Document ND105 and/or ND106} and reasonably in accordance with the progress of the Main Contract Works or each relevant Section of them subject to:

children.name: text
children: in respect of construction but not design work, receipt by the Sub-Contractor of a notice to commence work in accordance with the Sub-Contract Particulars; and

children.name: text
children: clauses 2.16 to 2.19.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Sub-Contract, no extension of time will be given pursuant to clause 2.18 or otherwise unless the Sub-Contractor has been delayed in the execution of the Sub-Contract Works by:

children.name: text
children: any event for which the Contractor has obtained an extension of time under the Main Contract; or

children.name: text
children: (subject to clauses 2.3.6 and 2.3.7) any impediment, prevention or default, whether by act or omission, of the Contractor or any of the Contractor's Persons (including where the Contractor is the Principal Contractor, any default whether by act or omission in that capacity) except to the extent caused or contributed to by any default, whether by act or omission, of the Sub-Contractor or any of the Sub-Contractor's Persons.

children.name: text
children: If at any time in the opinion of the Contractor reasonable progress in the performance of the Sub-Contract Works is not being maintained, then the Contractor upon giving written notice to the Sub-Contractor may:

children.name: text
children: request that the Sub-Contractor provide the Contractor with his proposals for measures to expedite the progress of the Sub-Contract Works (and which the Sub-Contractor shall provide within five (5) Business Days of receipt of any such request); and/or

children.name: text
children: instruct the Sub-Contractor to carry out all or any of the measures for expediting the progress of the Sub-Contract Works proposed pursuant to clause 2.3.3.1; and/or

children.name: text
children: (without prejudice to its right to determine under clause 7) accelerate the progress of the Sub-Contract Works by the employment of its own labour or that of other contractors and any additional expense directly or indirectly so incurred by the Contractor shall be paid without delay to the Contractor by or be otherwise recoverable from the Sub-Contractor as a debt,

children.name: text
children: provided that the Sub-Contractor shall not have or make any claim for an extension of time under clause 2.18 or any claim for loss and/or expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15 in connection with this clause 2.3.3.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any other rights and remedies of the Contractor, if the Sub-Contractor fails to comply in any respects with this clause 2.3, the Sub-Contractor shall be liable to the Contractor for any loss or damage suffered or incurred or reasonably anticipated to be suffered or incurred by the Contractor as a consequence of such failure. Any such sum or sums in respect of such liability shall be paid as a debt or allowed to the Contractor by the Sub-Contractor without delay.

children.name: text
children: Prior to commencement of the Sub-Contract Works the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor a hard and soft (electronic in Asta Powerproject PP file or XML file format) copy of a programme (in the form of a detailed Gantt chart detailing the critical path, task dependencies, task float and total float) for the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works, and if and whenever there is any delay or disruption to the execution of the Sub-Contract Works, the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor a revised programme for the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works and shall set out the measures the Sub-Contractor is taking or proposes to take to minimise or make good such delay or disruption. The Sub-Contractor shall also provide to the Contractor a progress report in a format approved by the Contractor no less frequently than monthly, which will include a percentage progress mark-up, jagged line and re-scheduled views of the programme. Compliance by the Sub-Contractor with the requirements of this clause 2.3.5 shall be a condition precedent to any entitlement of the Sub-Contractor to any extension of time under clause 2.18 and/or to loss and expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor acknowledges that work will be carried out by others on or around the Site which may be affected by the Sub-Contract Works. The Sub-Contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied itself that the programme for the Sub-Contract Works shall not cause any delay or disruption to any other party carrying out work on or around the Site. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Contractor against any liability, damage, loss, expense, cost, claim or proceedings arising out of or in connection with any failure of the Sub-Contractor to ensure that the Sub-Contract Works do not delay or inhibit the other parties working on or around the Site.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall further ensure that the programme includes the details of works carried out by others which might affect the Sub-Contract Works and shall fully co-operate with the Contractor and with all other contractors employed by the Contractor, the Employer or any other person with an interest in the Site to plan and execute the Sub-Contract Works taking into account the degree of interference expected of a project of the same size, scope and complexity as the Main Contract Works. Any impediment to the Sub-Contract Works which in the reasonable opinion of the Contractor should have been anticipated by the Sub-Contractor in the programme shall not entitle the Sub-Contractor to any extension of time under clause 2.18 and/or to loss and expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15.

children: {b:Clause 2.3A}

children.name: text
children: Insert a new clause 2.3A as follows:

children.name: text
children: "Notwithstanding clause 2.3, the Contractor may, use or occupy the site or the Sub-Contract Works or any part of them, whether for storage or otherwise:

children.name: text
children: on such dates stated in {b:Numbered Document ND113} (or on such other dates agreed by the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor); and

children.name: text
children: before the date of practical completion of the Sub-Contract Works or (where completion by Sections applies) the date of practical completion of the relevant Section of the Sub-Contract Works,{br}
provided that:

children.name: text
children: nothing in this clause 2.3A shall constitute a waiver of any right or remedy of the Contractor nor operate to exclude or limit the Sub-Contractor's obligations under or in connection with this Sub-Contract;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall obtain confirmation that such use or occupation by the Contractor will not prejudice the insurance maintained pursuant to Insurance Options A, B or C of the Main Contract; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor's exercise of its rights under this clause 2.3A shall not entitle the Sub-Contractor to an extension of time under clause 2.18 or to any loss and/or expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15."

children.name: text
children: Insert a new clause 2.3B as follows:

children.name: text
children: "If in the sole opinion of the Contractor, any Contractor's Persons is not suitable to carry out the Sub-Contract Works, the Contractor may issue an instruction to the Sub-Contractor to remove the individual from the project. The Contractor's exercise of its rights under this clause 2.3B shall not entitle the Sub-Contractor to an extension of time under clause 2.18 or to any loss and/or expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15."

children.name: text
children: Insert new clause 2.4.7 as follows:

children.name: text
children: "Notwithstanding the foregoing of this clause 2.4, all materials and goods for the Sub-Contract Works and the workmanship of the Sub-Contract Works shall be of satisfactory quality and comply with the standards, quality and requirements set out in the Main Contract. To the extent that there is any conflict or discrepancy between the standards, quality and requirements set out in the Main Contract and this Sub-Contract the Sub-Contractor shall comply with the higher or more onerous standard, quality or requirement."

children: Insert new clause 2.5.3 as follows:

children.name: text
children: "Without prejudice to any and all other obligations which the Sub-Contractor has under this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contractor shall provide the Contractor with all necessary early warnings, applications, notices and any other communications in sufficient time and detail to enable the Contractor to comply with any obligations it may have under the Main Contract. In the event that the Sub-Contractor is in breach of this obligation, it shall not be entitled to (and hereby waives) any or all relevant additional payment, extension of time or other remedy or relief and shall indemnify the Contractor in relation to any losses suffered by the Contractor resulting from such breach."

children.name: text
